entities.summary: Szamotuły is a town in western Poland, in Greater Poland Voivodeship, about 35 kilometres northwest of the centre of Poznań. It is the seat of Szamotuły County and of the smaller administrative district Gmina Szamotuły. The population was 19,090 in 2011.
